- What is your operating system?

- What anti-virus/security software are you running, if any?

Thunderbird has never created folders with those names. Therefore, either Earthlink or something local to your computer has created them. My first suspicion is an anti-virus or other security software you're running on your computer. If you are using one, there should be a setting in there somewhere so disable whatever feature is creating them.
